claims.claim: EU leaders opened two days of talks in Brussels on Thursday focused on China, energy prices, the 2028-2034 budget and Ukraine.
claims.episode_span: European Union leaders opened talks in Brussels on Thursday
claims.source_title: EU summit to focus on China, Ukraine and bloc budget
claims.supporting_quote: European Union leaders are to meet in Brussels on Thursday for two days of talks that will focus on some of the major economic challenges facing the bloc, including competition from China.

claims.claim: The EU trade deficit with China reached 360 billion euros last year.
claims.episode_span: the deficit with China reached €360 billion
claims.source_title: EU summit to focus on China, Ukraine and bloc budget
claims.supporting_quote: The leaders are expected to discuss ways to remedy the bloc's massive trade deficit with China, which reached €360 billion ($400.4 billion) last year and is set to exceed that level this year.

claims.claim: Oil remains above 100 dollars a barrel despite a coordinated G7 release.
claims.episode_span: oil remains above $100 a barrel despite a coordinated G7 release
claims.source_title: EU leaders enter crunch talks on energy, China and the budget
claims.supporting_quote: Oil remains above $100 per barrel despite a coordinated G7 release, with the International Energy Agency (IEA) warning Wednesday that Europe could face renewed wholesale diesel price rises in the coming weeks.

claims.claim: Kaja Kallas called the US-Russia diesel deal a gift to Putin.
claims.episode_span: the US-Russia diesel deal is a "gift to Putin"
claims.source_title: EU leaders enter crunch talks on energy, China and the budget
claims.supporting_quote: The EU’s foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas has just told Europe Today that the US-Russia diesel deal is a “gift to Putin”, while defending Ukraine’s right to hit Russian oil refineries.

claims.claim: Zelenskyy told Piers Morgan he felt betrayed.
claims.episode_span: Zelenskyy told Piers Morgan he feels "betrayed"
claims.source_title: EU leaders enter crunch talks on energy, China and the budget
claims.supporting_quote: Asked whether he felt betrayed, Zelenskyy answered: “Really, yes,” although he stressed that the situation was more complicated than his personal feelings.

claims.claim: Tens of thousands of students protested in Tirana and a government building and two banks were set alight.
claims.episode_span: Tens of thousands of students marched in Tirana
claims.source_title: Student protests in Albania turn violent as demonstrators clash with police
claims.supporting_quote: Tens of thousands of students have taken to the streets of Tirana, the Albanian capital, setting alight a government building and two banks and hurling stones at police during a protest over rising education costs and ⁠corruption.

claims.claim: French anti-terror prosecutors took over a school shooting inquiry near Marseille involving a 14-year-old suspect.
claims.episode_span: The French anti-terrorism prosecutor has taken over the investigation into a school shooting near Marseille.
claims.source_title: French anti-terror investigators probe True Crime Community link to school shooting
claims.supporting_quote: The French anti-terrorism prosecutor has taken ​over the investigation into a school shooting near Marseille, after an initial probe found the 14-year-old suspect appeared to belong to ​a ‌group called the True Crime ⁠Community.

claims.claim: Serbia holds parliamentary elections on October 25.
claims.episode_span: before Serbia's parliamentary elections on October 25
claims.source_title: Rising Violence is a Sign that Serbia’s Ruling Party is Panicking
claims.supporting_quote: They have all been reported in the space of a few weeks, as Serbia gets closer to parliamentary elections on October 25.

claims.claim: Polish incomes rose from 40 percent of the EU average in the mid-1990s to 81 percent last year.
claims.episode_span: from 40 percent of the EU average in the mid-1990s to 81 percent last year
claims.source_title: Poland looks to economic heights in a country transformed since Soviet days
claims.supporting_quote: Excluding oil-exporting states and financial hubs, incomes have converged with western levels at the fastest rate in the world; from 40% of the EU average in the mid-1990s to 81% last year.

claims.claim: Britain will provide 17 million pounds for Chornobyl repairs.
claims.episode_span: Britain will provide £17 million ($23 million) to repair the Chornobyl shelter
claims.source_title: Ukraine war briefing: UK pledges £17m to repair Chornobyl attack damage
claims.supporting_quote: Britain will provide £17m ($23m) to fund critical repairs to the Chornobyl power plant hit by a Russian drone attack

claims.claim: Marine Le Pen said France can no longer finance Ukraine.
claims.source_title: France 'can no longer finance' Ukraine, far-right presidential frontrunner Le Pen says
claims.supporting_quote: "We can no longer finance Ukraine," Le Pen told reporters in Brussels .

claims.claim: John James English said the Waterford attack was over a 20,000 euro drug debt incurred by somebody else.

claims.supporting_quote: John James English, Philip English’s adult son from his first marriage, said the debt had been incurred by somebody else, not his father.

claims.claim: A class of about 200 Garda recruits is expected to push membership above 14,800.
claims.episode_span: about 200 recruits passing out on Friday
